summary: Iteration 14 testing of 4 fix batches: F&O golden star, JPG heading colors, Domain Mapping CRUD+UI, Portfolio failed_symbols banner, Portfolio/Multibagger hover CSS. All 13 backend tests PASS. All frontend acceptance criteria PASS. One CSS specificity bug found and fixed in App.css (portfolio hover was overridden by a more-specific conflicting rule).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: App.css had CSS specificity conflict - '[data-testid="portfolio-page"] [data-testid*="portfolio-stock-"]:hover' (specificity 0,3,0) was overriding the Fix 3 rule '[data-testid*="portfolio-stock-"]:hover' (specificity 0,2,0), causing background to be rgba(255,255,255,0.08) instead of solid #FFFFFF. Fixed by: (1) removing portfolio-stock-hover from the generic group rule, (2) adding the portfolio-page prefix to Fix 3 rule so both rules are equally specific but Fix 3 (being later in file) wins. Also removed conflicting child element color rules at old lines 112-115.

MINOR: The F&O export hidden table check for '#1E3A5F' detects as 'False' via JavaScript string search because the browser normalizes hex to rgb(). Actual color is correct: rgb(30,58,95) = #1E3A5F white text on dark background - confirmed correct.
NOTE: MultiBagger hover CSS uses 'tr.result-row' class to increase specificity over generic 'tr:hover' - CSS specificity is correct and correctly overrides conflicting rules.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test domain 'ui-test-14.example.com' and 'test-iteration14.example.com' via API/UI for testing.
